        - heading "Definition" [level=3]
        - paragraph: A cumulative frequency curve (ogive) plots cumulative frequencies against upper class boundaries.
      - article:
        - heading "Formula" [level=3]
        - paragraph: Use interpolation within each class interval to estimate a percentile from the curve.
      - article:
        - heading "Worked example" [level=3]
        - paragraph: The median corresponds to N/2 = 20. Read across to the curve and interpolate within its class.
